originals.why: Natural Welsh: 'mae'n amser mynd' followed by 'ar ôl i ni orffen' means it's time to go after we finish. The Korean keeps the Welsh word order so it cannot be confused with o6.
Natural, idiomatic Welsh with the fronted time clause, and it uses the LEGO in the sense this course taught.

originals.ko: 정말 고마워, 하지만 지금 갈 시간이야

originals.why: 'dim diolch' followed by 'mae'n amser mynd' is a natural way to decline politely and leave. It uses the LEGO in its taught sense.

originals.ko: 갈 시간이야, 왜냐하면 우리는 여섯 시에 만나고 싶으니까
갈 시간이야, 하지만 나는 멈추고 싶지 않아
